message:
test(keepalive-multi r3): the clipboard across two kept PCs -- what a parked PC received is applied nowhere

km_multiclip_e2e_test (TEST ONLY): two fail-closed pinned test hosts (no capture, clipboard
sync on) on the private window station, two of the product's client sessions
(ClientSessionController) in the product's SessionTable; every phone-side clipboard action
resolves the binding taken when it is made through SessionTable::FindByBinding, as
native_bridge.cpp's bound_entry does; the phone's clipboard is a mock sink (what
drainIncomingClipboard hands to setPrimaryClip). The two hosts share the station's one
clipboard, so who received what is read from each host's own "[clipboard] update applied
utf16Count=N" and from the sink -- every text has its own length.
1 A takes HA in (held: the app does not drain it), a phone copy P_old still pending in A,
  A parks, B is shown: HA through A's old binding = nothing, through B = nothing, the sink
  never gets HA, host B gets neither.
2 a copy with A's stale binding is refused; B's new copy reaches host B only; a host copy
  while B is shown reaches the phone through B.
3 back to A: nothing of A's park time (HA held at the park, HB) is replayed, P_old is not
  pushed after the resume (nor during the park); a new host copy reaches the phone through
  A, a new phone copy reaches host A only.
Controls: a host copy reaches the phone through A while A is shown; --held-control: after
the same hold with A still shown, A's session holds HA. The user's WinSta0 clipboard
sequence is unchanged; both hosts still running when judged (the no-capture test host ends
itself ~30 s after its client -- the sequence takes ~11 s).
30/0 x3 (exit 0), held control 15/0. No product change.
